div.div:
Reading the gate line
wait — the wave is Ready when the objects it applies are Ready.
healthChecks (bold in the box) — wait is deliberately absent. The objects worth gating on are StatefulSets and GrafanaManifests an operator creates later, so they are never in the wave's own applied set and wait would pass instantly. Listing them is the only thing that holds the next wave back (RFC-0028 / ADR-065).
The two are mutually exclusive and wait wins, so a wave setting both gates only on what it applies.
